description: Workers Issues observability.issues.enabled is documented at https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/observability/issues/ (Wrangler 4.134.0+), including disabling Issues when omitted on redeploy. The 2026-10-05 spec adds issues to the script-settings shapes but still requires top-level enabled on the PATCH request. Alchemy WorkerIssues.test.ts live tests on 2026-10-05 verified a minimal issues-only PATCH false-to-true without top-level enabled; make enabled optional on the PATCH request only, leaving response requirements unchanged.
